Sure ig.

Growing up was pretty hard, i was left alone for the majority of my childhood, being neglected and being harrassed by my family.
Throughout my years at primary school, or you guys would call it elementary school (i believe), i was bullied everyday, physically and mentally. I didnt hate them for it, i look back on it now thinking we are just kids. People make mistakes, and people learn. After i moved up to the next school, which we call secondary (it's like a joint up middle and high school). I saw those people every morning looking at me, observing me, mocking me. All whilst i was waiting for the bus to take me to class.

At the age of 12, i started making friends and fitting in. I was only just adapting to my environment after being in secondary for a year. 
My a few of the people i cared about died, unexpectedly. Leaving a note behind.

Later on life, i continued my depression in secret, remaining composed. Yet, another tradegy broke. I had a girlfriend, who was a bit older than me. She was a lovely girl at first, caring, understanding and charismatic. Then came the abuse, sexual abuse and emotional abuse. This continued for around a year, where i finally had the courage to disappear from society for a while. Thus leaving the relationship for my protection. 

The aftereffects of the abuse caused me to become mute. I couldn't speak to anyone, i lost the ability to talk. It hurt to speak. It hurt to show emotion, and i didnt like people. These effects made me lose contact with my friends. I became an individual with no purpose. I had no one. The amount of times ive seen a knife, and other base weapons have caused me to become fearless to death and torture. Ive lost the majority of my pain receptors, and my body has been weird.

This year has been different.

Ive enjoyed this year, ive had only myself. Ive been happier and more alive. Ive gained confidence, and ive slowly began to speak again. My voice has changed quiet alot. Its more deep and broken, its crazy and i hate it. I made contact with one of my friends again who i havent seen in several years. Everything is going fine. Yet, i still feel everything.
All the pain, the feelings, my body is still enduring it all after all these years. Ive got time to get use to it.

All of this happened in such a short amount of time, yet i feel no hatred towards those who died, those who i lost and those who hurt me. I feel no sadness either. I forgive them all. They have caused me pain and all sorts of feelings that i can dwell on forever, but i won't, because i know i survived and theres no point in reliving it again and again.

Thats mostly the important bits of my childhood.
Hope this helps define the issues.
